name: Warwick's Best Summer Camp
operator_name: Warwick's Best After School and Summer Camp
description_short: A general day camp in Warwick, RI. Campers are grouped by age for planned games, arts and crafts, park and pool outings, field trips and special guests. Before and after care is available, and families can sign up for the full summer or for single weeks.
swim_waterfront_notes: The page says campers go to the pool on outings. It does not say where, how often, or how swimming is supervised.

warnings: The page calls itself static and not regularly updated. It gives no season year, dates, prices or ages. Current details are only shown after you submit contact information.

Some sections look like leftover template text from a martial arts/'ninja' class site (e.g. 'Why Warwick parents love Classes', 'amazing ninja moves', 'Traditional Sports vs. Classes'). These are probably not about the camp.
The site runs on a third-party marketing platform (New Member Ninja / Journey Group, Tulsa, OK). The content seems to come from the camp itself.
